title_en: Amendment (VI) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
Article 1: Article 134 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever violates the provisions on safety management in production or operation, thereby causing a serious accident involving heavy casualties or causing other serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
"Whoever compels another person to operate in violation of regulations and take risks, thereby causing a serious accident involving heavy casualties or causing other serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years."

Article 2: Article 135 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where the safety production facilities or the conditions for safety production do not meet the state provisions, thereby causing a serious accident involving heavy casualties or causing other serious consequences, the persons directly in charge and other persons directly liable shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years."

Article 3: A new Article is added after Article 135 of the Criminal Law as Article 135A: "Where the holding of a large-scale mass activity violates the provisions on safety management, thereby causing a serious accident involving heavy casualties or causing other serious consequences, the persons directly in charge and other persons directly liable shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years."

Article 4: A new Article is added after Article 139 of the Criminal Law as Article 139A: "Where, after the occurrence of a safety accident, a person who has the duty to report fails to report or falsely reports the accident circumstances, thereby delaying the rescue of the accident, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years."

Article 5: Article 161 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where a company or enterprise that has the obligation of information disclosure according to law provides false financial and accounting reports or conceals important facts to its shareholders and the general public, or fails to disclose other important information that shall be disclosed according to law in accordance with the provisions, thereby seriously harming the interests of shareholders or other persons, or where there are other serious circumstances, the persons directly in charge and other persons directly liable shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan."

Article 6: A new Article is added after Article 162A of the Criminal Law as Article 162B: "Where a company or enterprise carries out a false bankruptcy by concealing property, assuming fictitious debts, or using other methods to transfer or dispose of property, thereby seriously harming the interests of creditors or other persons, the persons directly in charge and other persons directly liable shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan."

Article 7: Article 163 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where an employee of a company, enterprise, or any other unit takes advantage of his position to demand money or property from another person, or illegally accept money or property from another person, and seeks benefits for that person, if the amount is relatively large, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention; if the amount is huge, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years, and may also be sentenced to confiscation of property.
Where an employee of a company, enterprise, or any other unit, in economic transactions, takes advantage of his position to accept various kinds of rebates or handling fees in violation of state provisions and takes them into his own possession, he shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
Where a person engaged in public service in a state-owned company, enterprise, or any other state-owned unit, or a person assigned by a state-owned company, enterprise, or any other state-owned unit to a non-state-owned company, enterprise, or any other unit to engage in public service commits any of the acts mentioned in the preceding two paragraphs, he shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Articles 385 and 386 of this Law."

Article 8: Paragraph 1 of Article 164 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever gives property to an employee of a company, enterprise, or any other unit for the purpose of seeking illegitimate benefits, if the amount is relatively large, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the amount is huge, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined."

Article 10: A new Article is added after Article 175 of the Criminal Law as Article 175A: "Whoever obtains loans, bill acceptance, letters of credit, letters of guarantee, or the like from a bank or any other financial institution by deceptive means, causing significant losses to the bank or other financial institution or having other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if causing especially significant losses to the bank or other financial institution or having other especially serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph, the unit shall be fined, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly liable shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 12: A new Article is added after Article 185 of the Criminal Law as Article 185A: "Where a commercial bank, stock exchange, futures exchange, securities company, futures brokerage company, insurance company, or any other financial institution, in violation of its fiduciary duty, unauthorizedly uses customer funds or other entrusted or trust property, if the circumstances are serious, the unit shall be fined, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly liable shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined not less than 30,000 yuan but not more than 300,000 yuan; if the circumstances are especially serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan.
Where a social security fund management institution, housing provident fund management institution, or other public fund management institution, as well as an insurance company, insurance asset management company, or securities investment fund management company, uses funds in violation of state provisions, the persons directly in charge and other persons directly liable shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 13: Paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 186 of the Criminal Law are amended as: "Where an employee of a bank or any other financial institution grants loans in violation of state provisions, if the amount is huge or causes significant losses, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan; if the amount is especially huge or causes especially significant losses, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years, and shall also be fined not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan.
Where an employee of a bank or any other financial institution, in violation of state provisions, grants loans to connected persons, shall be given a severe punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 14: Paragraph 1 of Article 187 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where an employee of a bank or any other financial institution fails to enter customer funds into the accounts, if the amount is huge or causes significant losses, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined not less than 20,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan; if the amount is especially huge or causes especially significant losses, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years, and shall also be fined not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan."

Article 15: Paragraph 1 of Article 188 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where an employee of a bank or any other financial institution, in violation of provisions, issues letters of credit or other letters of guarantee, bills, certificates of deposit, or credit certificates to another person, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years."

Article 17: A new Article is added after Article 262 of the Criminal Law as Article 262A: "Whoever organizes disabled persons or minors under the age of 14 to beg by means of violence or coercion shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined."

Article 18: Article 303 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, for the purpose of profit, gathers a crowd to engage in gambling or makes gambling his occupation shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined.
Whoever opens a casino shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined."

Article 19: Article 312 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, knowing that the property is criminal proceeds or gains derived therefrom, conceals, transfers, acquires, sells on behalf of another person, or conceals or disguises it by other means shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined."

Article 20: A new Article is added after Article 399 of the Criminal Law as Article 399A: "Any person who bears arbitration responsibility according to law, and who intentionally violates facts and the law to make a perverse arbitration award in an arbitration activity, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years."
Article 21: This Amendment shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
